name: Find your way around a codebase
when: Someone asks what a codebase does, what depends on something in it, or what a change would touch, and a coder card is wired to you.
procedure: If the folder has no map yet, run map_folder once. Do not map it again in the same conversation.
For how something works, ask_graph with a plain question, e.g. "how are payments stored".
For what a change touches, affected_by with the function, class or file name.
Read only the files the map names, and only the parts you need.
Answer with the names the map gave (functions, files), so the founder can follow them.
pitfalls: A map shows how the code is wired, not what it does when it runs: check behaviour in the code or with the coder.
A map is as old as its date. After big changes, run map_folder again before trusting it.
The map's files are generated. Never edit them or hand them to the coder to change.
verify: The answer names the functions and files it rests on, and says how old the map was.
